combination.rule: sentence := SPACES? SUBJECT SPACES? VERBPHRASE (AND VERBPHRASE)*; VERBPHRASE := VERB SPACES? (IGNORED SPACES?)? COMPLEMENT; after the subject, verb phrases are tried in listed order and the first whose verb+ignored+complement matches is used; after each phrase, AND is tried and, if it matches, the candidate list is reset to all verb phrases of the same subject. Command validity requires subject non-empty and at least one verb phrase matching.
